input: Any commit that modifies /moves/$k.text for any Black agent $k must also modify /turn/ply.num and be signed by pawn_e7 and at least twelve other Black agents' keys from /team/pieces, so a move only counts if it carries the team's plan co-signatures for the current ply.
response: always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -modifies(/turn/ply.num)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -signed_by(/team/pieces/pawn_e7.id)] false) & always([+modifies(/moves/$k.text) -threshold("13", /team/pieces)] false)
